---
title: "Current implementation and first use"
---

Offline mail, calendar, contacts, tasks, reminders, notes and feeds, with explicit account refresh. IMAP reading and manual Nextcloud sync are connected; sending, Microsoft 365 sign-in and background sync are unavailable in the production UI.

This page describes the October–November 2026 source revision. These source changes are not part of older development release downloads. Local checks are distinct from device, live-service and store acceptance.

## Build from a clean checkout

Flutter 3.47.9 / Dart 3.13.7, Python 3, JDK 17, Android SDK 36 and build-tools 35.0.0. Set JAVA_HOME and ANDROID_HOME. A device/emulator is required to install; a full Xcode installation is needed for iOS.

```sh
flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile
flutter analyze
flutter test
flutter build apk --debug --target-platform android-arm64
adb install -r build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk
```

These commands build from this source tree. Debug APKs are development artifacts; release bundles need private signing and device acceptance. A successful build is not a store submission.

## Use and verification

Read the [repository README](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-courrier/blob/main/README.md) for the exact application workflow, privacy/storage behavior and platform differences. The [October–November refinement record](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-courrier/blob/main/docs/refinement-2026-10.md) records findings, changes, observed checks, deferred work and the next release action. Local checks alone do not establish remote CI results.

For published source `7ca7cef025ba`, [application CI](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-courrier/actions/runs/41200136886) passed on 2026-10-31, including Android packaging and full unsigned iOS compilation. This historical compilation result does not establish installed iOS behavior, live-account acceptance or signed distribution; the later scoped Android result follows below.

On 2026-11-02, the debug APK identified in the refinement record passed offline note creation → save → force-stop/relaunch → exact title/body recovery on an API 35 ARM64/4 KiB emulator. Keep editing retained an unsaved draft; Discard preserved the saved note. The October 31 system failure remains historical evidence. Notifications, locking, live accounts, broader device acceptance and signed distribution remain open.

The [November Apple and desktop follow-up](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-courrier/blob/main/docs/apple-refinement-2026-11-08.md) adds keyboard navigation and corrects Keychain capability and privacy-manifest packaging. For a local macOS preview, run `scripts/build-macos-preview.sh` after dependency installation. This ad-hoc artifact is distinct from a team-signed build and does not establish credential persistence acceptance.
